title: player.config (server → platform, ephemeral)
description: Proposed by Ready Up (the playersettings plugin). A connected player's CS2 config as their game reported it, read once per map: `crosshair_code` the share code from their controller (CS2's `CS` + 44 characters, or the old CSGO-xxxxx-xxxxx-xxxxx-xxxxx-xxxxx), `cvars` the answers to cvar queries (name → value as the game sent it). The platform keeps it for the player's profile (the Config tab) unless they turned that off, and ignores cvars it does not show.
